description: Runs all 755 compliance checks (or the frameworks named) on one governance record in a single call. Returns the overall score, a score for every framework, and the fixes that unlock the most checks first. By default seals the scorecard into Bitcoin with its own page and code (SC-XXXX-XXXX) to send to an auditor or insurer; send seal=false to just look. Agent-output gates run too when input_payload/output_payload are given. Only a fingerprint of the record is kept.

detail.description: Also list every failing check by framework.

frameworks.description: Framework keys (e.g. euaiact, gdpr, dora, iso42001) as a list or comma-separated; leave out for all.

input_payload.description: For agent-output gates: what went into the AI step.

org.description: Organisation or system name shown on the scorecard.

output_payload.description: For agent-output gates: what the AI step produced.

seal.description: Seal into Bitcoin with a public scorecard page (default true).

name: sebbi_run_everything
title: Run every check, sealed scorecard
